shortDescription: Afya Limited, or “Afya” (NASDAQ:AFYA; B3: A2FY34) announced today that the following resolutions set out in its Notice of Extraordinary General Meeting dated November 4, 2026 were duly passed at its Extraordinary General Meeting held today with approximately 91% of total shares in attendance and ap…

children: announced today that the following resolutions set out in its Notice of Extraordinary General Meeting dated November 4, 2026 were duly passed at its Extraordinary General Meeting held today with approximately 91% of total shares in attendance and approximately 99% of votes cast in favor (including both Class A and Class B shares):

(1) (a) the authorisation, approval and confirmation in all respects of the Merger Agreement and Other Covenants dated September 23, 2026, entered into by Afya Limited (the “Company”) and YDUQS Participações S.A., a publicly held corporation (

) incorporated under the laws of Brazil (“YDUQS” and “Merger Agreement,” respectively); (b) the authorisation for the Company to merge with and into YDUQS as a result of which the Company shall cease to exist and all the undertaking, property and liabilities of the Company shall vest in YDUQS as the surviving company by virtue of such merger (the “Merger”), pursuant to the provisions of Part 16 of the Companies Act (As Revised); and (c) the authorisation, approval and confirmation in all respects of the Plan of Merger in substantially the form annexed as Annex A to the proxy statement (the “Plan of Merger”), including the amendments to the By-Laws of the surviving company as set out in the Plan of Merger, and the authorisation for the Company to enter into the Plan of Merger;
(2) the authorisation, approval and confirmation in all respects of the Brazilian Merger Protocol and Justification (
) between management of the Company and YDUQS in substantially the form annexed as Annex B to the proxy statement (the “Brazilian Merger Protocol”);
(3) the authorisation for the Company to enter into the Brazilian Merger Protocol;

(4) the ratification and approval in all respects of the appointment and engagement of Apsis Consultoria e Avaliações Ltda. as a specialized appraiser firm responsible for the preparation of the appraisal report of the Company’s net equity at book value as of the June 30, 2026 base date, pursuant to Articles 226 and 227, §3 of the Brazilian Corporate Law (the “Appraisal Report”);
(5) the authorisation, approval and confirmation in all respects of the Appraisal Report; and

(6) the approval, ratification and confirmation in all respects of all actions taken and any documents or agreements executed, signed or delivered prior to or after the date hereof by any director or officer of the Company in connection with the transactions contemplated hereby.

Completion of the Merger remains subject to the fulfillment or waiver (if applicable) of the other conditions precedent contained in the Merger Agreement, including but not limited to the approval of the antitrust authorities in Brazil and no material adverse changes to the businesses of each company.

Until the completion of the Merger, including antitrust approvals and other ordinary conditions required to close the transaction, Afya and YDUQS remain independent companies and continue to conduct their activities and business decisions autonomously. There are no immediate changes for students, employees, suppliers, and partners due to today’s approval at the Extraordinary General Meeting.

Afya is a leading medical education group in Brazil based on the number of medical school seats, delivering an end-to-end physician-centric ecosystem that serves and empowers students and physicians to transform their ambitions into rewarding lifelong experiences from the moment they join us as medical students through their medical residency preparation, graduation program, continuing medical education activities and offering medical practice solutions to help doctors enhance their healthcare services through their whole career.

This announcement is not an offer for sale of securities in the United States, nor a solicitation of votes or proxies. The securities have not been registered under the U.S. Securities Act of 1933, as amended (the “Securities Act”), and may not be offered or sold in the United States or to, or for the account or benefit of, any U.S. person absent registration or an exemption from registration under the Securities Act. The issuer does not intend to register any part of the offering in the United States or to conduct a public offering of securities in the United States.
